components.name: Primary Action Button
components.description: Interactive command button for simulator and critical actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #155DFC; color: #FFFFFF; font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: 10px; border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s ease, transform 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #1340B4; transform: translateY(-1px); }

components.name: Telemetry Node Card
components.description: Real-time edge sensor metric container with status pill and sparkline trend.
components.css: .ds-card-telemetry { background: #FFFFFF; border: 1px solid #E5E7EB; border-radius: 16px; padding: 20px; font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', sans-serif; transition: border-color 0.2s ease, transform 0.2s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease; } .ds-card-telemetry:hover { border-color: #CBD5E1; transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 4px 12px -2px rgba(0,0,0,0.06); } .ds-telemetry-header { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; color: #334155; margin-bottom: 8px; } .ds-badge-safe { background: #DCFCE7; color: #166534; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 9999px; } .ds-telemetry-val { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 24px; font-weight: 800; color: #0F172A; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-telemetry-unit { font-size: 12px; color: #64748B; font-weight: 500; }

narrative.overview: Disaster Sentinel operates in high-stakes emergency environments across Uttarakhand's river basins, unstable slope terrains, and pine perimeter forests. The visual system balances the rapid scanability of a mission-critical command console with the restraint, clarity, and ergonomic comfort required for long monitoring shifts.
keyCharacteristics: High-clarity typography with IBM Plex Sans and JetBrains Mono.
High-contrast hazard semantics strictly reserved for life safety.
Deep slate and midnight naval surfaces in dark mode.
Tabular numeric rhythm preventing layout jitter.

rules.name: The Hazard Exclusivity Rule
rules.body: Bright red and crimson are strictly forbidden as general decorative colors. Ruby is reserved exclusively for unacknowledged active alarms and threshold breaches.

rules.name: The Tabular Telemetry Rule
rules.body: All live numerical readouts must declare font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums and monospace styling to prevent layout shifts as values fluctuate.

rules.name: The Calm Surface Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are quiet and flat at rest; lift and glow appear only in response to operator hover or urgent sensor anomalies.

dos: Do format all sensor readings and numerical coordinates with tabular-nums.
Do test both light and dark mode for WCAG 2.1 AA text contrast (minimum 4.5:1).
Do reserve crimson accents exclusively for real-time hazard breaches.
Do provide clear units of measurement next to all live values.
donts: Don't use decorative gradient text or low-contrast pastel backgrounds.
Don't use colored left borders or heavy 4px card borders.
Don't use emoji or unstyled characters as telemetry icons.
Don't trigger disruptive full-screen modal takeovers for nominal background events.
